LESSON: COIL TECHNIQUES

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: MODELLING
Topic 2.2: Coil TECHNIQUES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Coil TECHNIQUES. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Where do you get c) model for enjoyment • Guide to make objects using coil modelling materials?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Coil TECHNIQUES
2. Practise Coil TECHNIQUES at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Coil TECHNIQUES

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Coil TECHNIQUES
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Coil TECHNIQUES. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Coil TECHNIQUES at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Coil TECHNIQUES at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Coil TECHNIQUES
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Coil TECHNIQUES. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Coil TECHNIQUES using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Coil TECHNIQUES in the examples.
2. Explain Coil TECHNIQUES to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Coil TECHNIQUES.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Coil TECHNIQUES using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Coil TECHNIQUES important for a PP2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Guide learners into working 2. What type of materials technique groups do you enjoy b) model items using coil
2. Guide to make objects using coil modelling materials? d) express their ideas, feelings technique. and emotions through
3. Be guided to take modelling. photographs of their finished objects
4. Guide learners to display, appreciate own and others work.
5. Guide learners to clear working area and wash their hands. Core-Competence

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Coil TECHNIQUES
2. Practise Coil TECHNIQUES at school and at home
